items.title: ReviewBench: An open benchmark for AI code review
items.summary: Agentic code review is becoming an essential piece of how development happens. It helps you inspect pull requests, catch issues, and decide what deserves attention before code ships. But the quality of existing AI reviewers can be hard to measure, and you need to know the strengths of a reviewer before you know if it will help you.
